sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śrutvā dvaipāyanavaco dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhrātṝn sarvān samānāyya kāle vacanam abravīt arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca mādrīputrau yamāv api
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having heard the words of Dvaipāyana, Yudhiṣṭhira the King of Righteousness gathered all his brothers and at the fitting time spoke—to Arjuna and Bhīmasena, and to the twin sons of Mādrī as well.

sanskrit: śrutaṃ vo vacanaṃ vīrāḥ sauhṛdād yan mahātmanā kurūṇāṃ hitakāmena proktaṃ kṛṣṇena dhīmatā
english: You have heard, O heroes, the counsel that out of friendship was spoken by the great-souled and wise Kṛṣṇa, who desires the welfare of the Kurus.

sanskrit: tapovṛddhena mahatā suhṛdāṃ bhūtim icchatā guruṇā dharmaśīlena vyāsenādbhutakarmaṇā
english: And by the great Vyāsa, grown mighty in austerity, wishing prosperity for his friends—our teacher, devoted to righteousness, of wondrous deeds.

sanskrit: bhīṣmeṇa ca mahāprājña govindena ca dhīmatā saṃsmṛtya tad ahaṃ samyak kartum icchāmi pāṇḍavāḥ
english: And by the deeply wise Bhīṣma and the sagacious Govinda. Recalling all this, I wish to carry it out duly, O Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca sarveṣāṃ tad dhi no hitam anubandhe ca kalyāṇaṃ yad vaco brahmavādinaḥ
english: For the word of those who expound the sacred truth is good for us all, both in the future and in the present, and brings blessing in its train.

sanskrit: iyaṃ hi vasudhā sarvā kṣīṇaratnā kurūdvahāḥ tac cācaṣṭa bahu vyāso maruttasya dhanaṃ nṛpāḥ
english: This whole earth has been drained of its treasures, O upholders of the Kurus; and Vyāsa spoke at length of the wealth of Marutta, O kings.

sanskrit: yady etad vo bahumataṃ manyadhvaṃ vā kṣamaṃ yadi tad ānayāmahe sarve kathaṃ vā bhīma manyase
english: If this seems right to you, and if you deem it fitting, let us all go to fetch it. What do you think, O Bhīma?

sanskrit: ity uktavākye nṛpatau tadā kurukulodvaha bhīmaseno nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ prāñjalir vākyam abravīt
english: When the king had thus spoken, O upholder of the Kuru line, Bhīmasena, with hands joined in reverence, addressed the foremost of kings.

sanskrit: rocate me mahābāho yad idaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tvayā vyāsākhyātasya vittasya samupānayanaṃ prati
english: It pleases me, O mighty-armed one, what you have said regarding the fetching of the wealth of which Vyāsa told.

sanskrit: yadi tat prāpnuyāmeha dhanam āvikṣitaṃ prabho kṛtam eva mahārāja bhaved iti matir mama
english: If we could but obtain that wealth of Marutta, the son of Avikṣit, O lord, then, O great king, our purpose would be as good as accomplished—such is my judgment.

sanskrit: te vayaṃ praṇipātena girīśasya mahātmanaḥ tad ānayāma bhadraṃ te samabhyarcya kapardinam
english: By bowing down to the great-souled Lord of the Mountain, and by worshipping the matted-haired one, may we fetch it. Blessings upon you!

sanskrit: taṃ vibhuṃ devadeveśaṃ tasyaivānucarāṃś ca tān prasādyārtham avāpsyāmo nūnaṃ vāgbuddhikarmabhiḥ
english: By propitiating that all-pervading Lord of the Lords of gods, and his attendants too, with word, thought, and deed, we shall surely gain our end.

sanskrit: rakṣante ye ca tad dravyaṃ kiṃkarā raudradarśanāḥ te ca vaśyā bhaviṣyanti prasanne vṛṣabhadhvaje
english: And those servants of fearsome aspect who guard that treasure will come under our sway once the bull-bannered god is gracious.

sanskrit: śrutvaivaṃ vadatas tasya vākyaṃ bhīmasya bhārata prīto dharmātmajo rājā babhūvātīva bhārata arjunapramukhāś cāpi tathety evābruvan mudā
english: Hearing Bhīma speak these words, O Bhārata, the king, the son of Dharma, was exceedingly pleased; and Arjuna and the others too said joyfully, So be it.

sanskrit: kṛtvā tu pāṇḍavāḥ sarve ratnāharaṇaniścayam senām ājñāpayām āsur nakṣatre 'hani ca dhruve
english: Then all the Pāṇḍavas, having resolved to bring back the treasure, commanded the army to make ready on a day and under a constellation that were steadfast and auspicious.

sanskrit: tato yayuḥ pāṇḍusutā brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca arcayitvā suraśreṣṭhaṃ pūrvam eva maheśvaram
english: Then the sons of Pāṇḍu set forth, having had the brāhmaṇas pronounce blessings, and having first of all worshipped Maheśvara, the foremost of the gods.

sanskrit: modakaiḥ pāyasenātha māṃsāpūpais tathaiva ca āśāsya ca mahātmānaṃ prayayur muditā bhṛśam
english: With sweetmeats, with milk-rice, and likewise with meat-cakes they made offering, and having prayed to the great god, they set out greatly rejoicing.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ prayāsyatāṃ tatra maṅgalāni śubhāny atha prāhuḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso dvijāgryā nāgarāś ca te
english: As they were setting out, the foremost of the twice-born and the citizens, their hearts gladdened, uttered for them auspicious benedictions.

sanskrit: tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śirobhiḥ praṇipatya ca brāhmaṇān agnisahitān prayayuḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ
english: Then, having walked round them with reverence and bowed their heads, the sons of Pāṇḍu set forth, taking the brāhmaṇas along with the sacred fires.

sanskrit: samanujñāpya rājānaṃ putraśokasamāhatam dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ sabhāryaṃ vai pṛthāṃ pṛthulalocanām
english: Having taken leave of King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, who was stricken with grief for his sons, together with his wife, and of the large-eyed Pṛthā.

sanskrit: mūle nikṣipya kauravyaṃ yuyutsuṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajam saṃpūjyamānāḥ pauraiś ca brāhmaṇaiś ca manīṣibhiḥ
english: And having placed Yuyutsu, the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra of the Kuru line, in charge at the root, they went honoured by the townsfolk and by the wise brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tatas te prayayur hṛṣṭāḥ prahṛṣṭanaravāhanāḥ rathaghoṣeṇa mahatā pūrayanto vasuṃdharām
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then they set forth in high spirits, their men and mounts rejoicing, filling the earth with the mighty rumble of their chariots.

sanskrit: saṃstūyamānāḥ stutibhiḥ sūtamāgadhabandibhiḥ svena sainyena saṃvītā yathādityāḥ svaraśmibhiḥ
english: Extolled with praises by bards, heralds, and panegyrists, and encompassed by their own army, they shone like the suns wreathed in their own rays.

sanskrit: pāṇḍureṇātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani babhau yudhiṣṭhiras tatra paurṇamāsyām ivoḍurāṭ
english: With a white parasol held above his head, Yudhiṣṭhira shone there like the lord of the stars, the moon, on the night of the full moon.

sanskrit: jayāśiṣaḥ prahṛṣṭānāṃ narāṇāṃ pathi pāṇḍavaḥ pratyagṛhṇād yathānyāyaṃ yathāvat puruṣarṣabhaḥ
english: Along the road the Pāṇḍava, that bull among men, duly and graciously received the benedictions of victory uttered by the gladdened people.

sanskrit: tathaiva sainikā rājan rājānam anuyānti ye teṣāṃ halahalāśabdo divaṃ stabdhvā vyatiṣṭhata
english: And so too, O king, of the soldiers who followed the king, the tumultuous clamour rose up and stood spanning the very heavens.

sanskrit: sa sarāṃsi nadīś caiva vanāny upavanāni ca atyakrāman mahārājo giriṃ caivānvapadyata
english: That great king crossed over lakes and rivers, forests and groves, and at last drew near the mountain.

sanskrit: tasmin deśe ca rājendra yatra tad dravyam uttamam cakre niveśanaṃ rājā pāṇḍavaḥ saha sainikaiḥ śive deśe same caiva tadā bharatasattama
english: And in that region, O lord of kings, where that supreme treasure lay, the Pāṇḍava king made his encampment together with his soldiers, on auspicious and level ground, O best of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: agrato brāhmaṇān kṛtvā tapovidyādamānvitān purohitaṃ ca kauravya vedavedāṅgapāragam
english: Placing in the van the brāhmaṇas, endowed with austerity, learning, and self-restraint, and his household priest, O Kaurava, versed in the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

sanskrit: prāṅ niveśāt tu rājānaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sapurodhasaḥ kṛtvā śāntiṃ yathānyāyaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan
english: Before the encamping, the brāhmaṇas, together with the household priest, having duly performed the rites of peace, surrounded the king on every side.

sanskrit: kṛtvā ca madhye rājānam amātyāṃś ca yathāvidhi ṣaṭpathaṃ navasaṃsthānaṃ niveśaṃ cakrire dvijāḥ
english: And having placed the king and his ministers in the centre according to rule, the twice-born laid out the camp with six pathways and nine quarters.

sanskrit: mattānāṃ vāraṇendrāṇāṃ niveśaṃ ca yathāvidhi kārayitvā sa rājendro brāhmaṇān idam abravīt
english: And having had the station of the rutting lordly elephants prepared according to rule, that lord of kings said this to the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: asmin kārye dvijaśreṣṭhā nakṣatre divase śubhe yathā bhavanto manyante kartum arhatha tat tathā
english: In this undertaking, O best of the twice-born, on an auspicious constellation and day, as you deem fit, so you ought to act.

sanskrit: na naḥ kālātyayo vai syād ihaiva parilambatām iti niścitya viprendrāḥ kriyatāṃ yad anantaram
english: Let there be no waste of time for us as we tarry here. Having determined this, O foremost of brāhmaṇas, let what comes next be done.

sanskrit: śrutvaitad vacanaṃ rājño brāhmaṇāḥ sapurodhasaḥ idam ūcur vaco hṛṣṭā dharmarājapriyepsavaḥ
english: Hearing this speech of the king, the brāhmaṇas together with the household priest, rejoicing and eager to please the King of Righteousness, spoke these words.

sanskrit: adyaiva nakṣatram ahaś ca puṇyaṃ; yatāmahe śreṣṭhatamaṃ kriyāsu ambhobhir adyeha vasāma rājann; upoṣyatāṃ cāpi bhavadbhir adya
english: This very day both the constellation and the day are holy; let us strive at the most excellent of rites. Today let us dwell here on water alone, O king, and let you too keep a fast this day.

sanskrit: śrutvā tu teṣāṃ dvijasattamānāṃ; kṛtopavāsā rajanīṃ narendrāḥ ūṣuḥ pratītāḥ kuśasaṃstareṣu; yathādhvareṣu jvalitā havyavāhāḥ
english: Hearing the words of those best of the twice-born, the lords of men kept the fast and passed the night, confident, upon beds of kuśa grass, like blazing sacrificial fires at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: tato niśā sā vyagaman mahātmanāṃ; saṃśṛṇvatāṃ viprasamīritā giraḥ tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijarṣabhā; vaco 'bruvan dharmasutaṃ narādhipam
english: Then that night passed for those great-souled ones as they listened to the words uttered by the brāhmaṇas; and at the clear dawn the bulls among the twice-born spoke to the son of Dharma, the lord of men.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ kriyatām upahāro 'dya tryambakasya mahātmanaḥ kṛtvopahāraṃ nṛpate tataḥ svārthe yatāmahe
english: The brāhmaṇas said: Let an offering be made today to the great-souled three-eyed god; and having made the offering, O king, let us then strive for our purpose.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ girīśasya yathānyāyam upahāram upāharat
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Hearing the words of those brāhmaṇas, Yudhiṣṭhira duly presented an offering to the Lord of the Mountain.

sanskrit: ājyena tarpayitvāgniṃ vidhivat saṃskṛtena ha mantrasiddhaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā purodhāḥ prayayau tadā
english: Having gratified the fire with clarified butter duly consecrated, and having prepared the sacrificial gruel hallowed with mantras, the household priest then went forth.

sanskrit: sa gṛhītvā sumanaso mantrapūtā janādhipa modakaiḥ pāyasenātha māṃsaiś copāharad balim
english: Taking flowers sanctified by mantras, O lord of men, he offered the oblation with sweetmeats, with milk-rice, and with meat.

sanskrit: sumanobhiś ca citrābhir lājair uccāvacair api sarvaṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ kṛtvā vidhivad vedapāragaḥ kiṃkarāṇāṃ tataḥ paścāc cakāra balim uttamam
english: With many-coloured flowers and with parched grains of various kinds, that master of the Vedas duly performed the whole rite of the sviṣṭakṛt oblation, and thereafter made a supreme offering to the attendant servants.

sanskrit: yakṣendrāya kuberāya maṇibhadrāya caiva ha tathānyeṣāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ bhūtādhipatayaś ca ye
english: To the lord of yakṣas, Kubera, and to Maṇibhadra, and likewise to the other yakṣas, and to those who are the overlords of beings.

sanskrit: kṛsareṇa samāṃsena nivāpais tilasaṃyutaiḥ śuśubhe sthānam atyarthaṃ devadevasya pārthiva
english: With sesame-and-rice mixed with meat, and with funerary offerings joined with sesame, the abode of the God of gods shone exceedingly bright, O king.

sanskrit: kṛtvā tu pūjāṃ rudrasya gaṇānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ yayau vyāsaṃ puraskṛtya nṛpo ratnanidhiṃ prati
english: Having performed worship of Rudra and of all his hosts, the king, placing Vyāsa at his head, went toward the treasure-store of jewels.

sanskrit: pūjayitvā dhanādhyakṣaṃ praṇipatyābhivādya ca sumanobhir vicitrābhir apūpaiḥ kṛsareṇa ca
english: Having worshipped the Lord of Wealth, and bowed down and saluted him, with diverse flowers, with cakes, and with sesame-rice.

sanskrit: śaṅkhādīṃś ca nidhīn sarvān nidhipālāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ arcayitvā dvijāgryān sa svasti vācya ca vīryavān
english: And having worshipped all the treasures beginning with the Śaṅkha and all the guardians of the treasures, that mighty one had the foremost brāhmaṇas pronounce their blessings.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa tejasā samavasthitaḥ prītimān sa kuruśreṣṭhaḥ khānayām āsa taṃ nidhim
english: Established in their splendour, amid the proclaiming of the holy day, that gladdened best of the Kurus had the treasure dug out.

sanskrit: tataḥ pātryaḥ sakarakāḥ sāśmantakamanoramāḥ bhṛṅgārāṇi kaṭāhāni kalaśān vardhamānakān
english: Then there were dishes and water-pots, lovely vessels of crystal, ewers, cauldrons, jars, and beautifully shaped urns.

sanskrit: bahūni ca vicitrāṇi bhājanāni sahasraśaḥ uddhārayām āsa tadā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: And many varied vessels by the thousands did Yudhiṣṭhira, the King of Righteousness, then have brought up.

sanskrit: teṣāṃ lakṣaṇam apy āsīn mahān karapuṭas tathā trilakṣaṃ bhājanaṃ rājaṃs tulārdham abhavan nṛpa
english: Their measure was as much as a great handful; three hundred thousand such vessels there were, O king, and each weighed half a tulā, O lord.

sanskrit: vāhanaṃ pāṇḍuputrasya tatrāsīt tu viśāṃ pate ṣaṣṭir uṣṭrasahasrāṇi śatāni dviguṇā hayāḥ
english: The means of conveyance of the son of Pāṇḍu there, O lord of peoples, were sixty thousand camels, and twice a hundred thousand horses.

sanskrit: vāraṇāś ca mahārāja sahasraśatasaṃmitāḥ śakaṭāni rathāś caiva tāvad eva kareṇavaḥ kharāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca parisaṃkhyā na vidyate
english: And elephants, O great king, numbering a hundred thousand, and wagons and chariots and as many she-elephants too; while of the asses and the men there was no reckoning.

sanskrit: etad vittaṃ tad abhavad yad uddadhre yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ṣoḍaśāṣṭau caturviṃśat sahasraṃ bhāralakṣaṇam
english: This was the wealth that Yudhiṣṭhira raised up: sixteen, eight, and twenty-four thousand in the measure of loads.

sanskrit: eteṣv ādhāya tad dravyaṃ punar abhyarcya pāṇḍavaḥ mahādevaṃ prati yayau puraṃ nāgāhvayaṃ prati
english: Having loaded that treasure upon these, and having worshipped Mahādeva once more, the Pāṇḍava set out toward the city named after the elephant.

sanskrit: dvaipāyanābhyanujñātaḥ puraskṛtya purohitam goyute goyute caiva nyavasat puruṣarṣabhaḥ
english: With the leave of Dvaipāyana, placing his household priest at the head, that bull among men halted at every distance of a goyuta.

sanskrit: sā purābhimukhī rājañ jagāma mahatī camūḥ kṛcchrād draviṇabhārārtā harṣayantī kurūdvahān
english: That great host, O king, made its way toward the city, struggling under the burden of the wealth, and gladdening the upholders of the Kurus.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca etasminn eva kāle tu vāsudevo 'pi vīryavān upāyād vṛṣṇibhiḥ sārdhaṃ puraṃ vāraṇasāhvayam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: At this very time, the mighty Vāsudeva too came, together with the Vṛṣṇis, to the city named after the elephant.

sanskrit: samayaṃ vājimedhasya viditvā puruṣarṣabhaḥ yathokto dharmaputreṇa vrajan sa svapurīṃ prati
english: That bull among men, knowing the appointed time of the horse-sacrifice as the son of Dharma had told him, came while journeying toward his own city.

sanskrit: raukmiṇeyena sahito yuyudhānena caiva ha cārudeṣṇena sāmbena gadena kṛtavarmaṇā
english: Accompanied by the son of Rukmiṇī, and by Yuyudhāna, by Cārudeṣṇa, Sāmba, Gada, and Kṛtavarman.

sanskrit: sāraṇena ca vīreṇa niśaṭhenolmukena ca baladevaṃ puraskṛtya subhadrāsahitas tadā
english: And by the hero Sāraṇa, by Niśaṭha and Ulmuka—placing Baladeva at their head, and together with Subhadrā then.

sanskrit: draupadīm uttarāṃ caiva pṛthāṃ cāpy avalokakaḥ samāśvāsayituṃ cāpi kṣatriyā nihateśvarāḥ
english: Wishing to look upon Draupadī, Uttarā, and Pṛthā, and also to console the kṣatriya women whose lords had been slain.

sanskrit: tān āgatān samīkṣyaiva dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ pratyagṛhṇād yathānyāyaṃ viduraś ca mahāmanāḥ
english: Seeing them arrive, King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, lord of the earth, received them duly, as did the high-minded Vidura.

sanskrit: tatraiva nyavasat kṛṣṇaḥ svarcitaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ vidureṇa mahātejās tathaiva ca yuyutsunā
english: There that bull among men, Kṛṣṇa of great splendour, dwelt, well honoured by Vidura and likewise by Yuyutsu.

sanskrit: vasatsu vṛṣṇivīreṣu tatrātha janamejaya jajñe tava pitā rājan parikṣit paravīrahā
english: While the Vṛṣṇi heroes were dwelling there, O Janamejaya, your father was born, O king—Parikṣit, the slayer of enemy heroes.

sanskrit: sa tu rājā mahārāja brahmāstreṇābhipīḍitaḥ śavo babhūva niśceṣṭo harṣaśokavivardhanaḥ
english: But that king, O great king, smitten by the brahmāstra, was born a corpse, motionless, swelling both joy and grief.

sanskrit: hṛṣṭānāṃ siṃhanādena janānāṃ tatra nisvanaḥ āviśya pradiśaḥ sarvāḥ punar eva vyupāramat
english: The clamour of the joyful people there, with its lion-roar, having filled all the quarters and the intermediate regions, fell silent once again.

sanskrit: tataḥ so 'titvaraḥ kṛṣṇo viveśāntaḥpuraṃ tadā yuyudhānadvitīyo vai vyathitendriyamānasaḥ
english: Then Kṛṣṇa in great haste entered the inner apartments at that time, with Yuyudhāna as his second, his senses and mind shaken.

sanskrit: tatas tvaritam āyāntīṃ dadarśa svāṃ pitṛṣvasām krośantīm abhidhāveti vāsudevaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
english: Then he saw his own father's sister coming swiftly toward him, crying out again and again to Vāsudeva, Run hither!

sanskrit: pṛṣṭhato draupadīṃ caiva subhadrāṃ ca yaśasvinīm savikrośaṃ sakaruṇaṃ bāndhavānāṃ striyo nṛpa
english: And behind her Draupadī, and the renowned Subhadrā, and the women of the kinsfolk, O king, crying out with lamentation and pity.

sanskrit: tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samāsādya kuntī rājasutā tadā provāca rājaśārdūla bāṣpagadgadayā girā
english: Then Kuntī, the king's daughter, having reached Kṛṣṇa, spoke to him, O tiger among kings, in a voice choked with tears.

sanskrit: vāsudeva mahābāho suprajā devakī tvayā tvaṃ no gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca tvadāyattam idaṃ kulam
english: O Vāsudeva, mighty-armed one, blessed in offspring is Devakī through you. You are our refuge and our support; this whole family depends upon you.

sanskrit: yadupravīra yo 'yaṃ te svasrīyasyātmajaḥ prabho aśvatthāmnā hato jātas tam ujjīvaya keśava
english: O foremost hero of the Yadus, this child, the son of your nephew, O lord, has been born slain by Aśvatthāman—bring him back to life, O Keśava!

sanskrit: tvayā hy etat pratijñātam aiṣīke yadunandana ahaṃ saṃjīvayiṣyāmi mṛtaṃ jātam iti prabho
english: For this you vowed at the hour of the reed-weapon, O delight of the Yadus: I shall revive him though born dead, O lord.

sanskrit: so 'yaṃ jāto mṛtas tāta paśyainaṃ puruṣarṣabha uttarāṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca draupadīṃ māṃ ca mādhava
english: This child here has been born dead, dear one—behold him, O bull among men—and behold Uttarā and Subhadrā and Draupadī and me, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: dharmaputraṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca phalgunaṃ nakulaṃ tathā sahadevaṃ ca durdharṣa sarvān nas trātum arhasi
english: And the son of Dharma, and Bhīma, and Phalguna, and Nakula, and Sahadeva too, O invincible one—you ought to save us all.

sanskrit: asmin prāṇāḥ samāyattāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mamaiva ca pāṇḍoś ca piṇḍo dāśārha tathaiva śvaśurasya me
english: Upon this child hang the very lives of the Pāṇḍavas and my own; and on him too, O Dāśārha, depend the funeral offerings to Pāṇḍu and to my father-in-law.

sanskrit: abhimanyoś ca bhadraṃ te priyasya sadṛśasya ca priyam utpādayādya tvaṃ pretasyāpi janārdana
english: Blessings on you—do today, O Janārdana, a kindness even to the departed, to the beloved Abhimanyu who was so worthy of you and so dear.

sanskrit: uttarā hi priyoktaṃ vai kathayaty arisūdana abhimanyor vacaḥ kṛṣṇa priyatvāt te na saṃśayaḥ
english: For Uttarā keeps repeating, O slayer of foes, the fond words spoken by Abhimanyu, out of her love for you, O Kṛṣṇa—of this there is no doubt.
